original: saṃsāra eva davāgniḥ sarvaśo vyāpya tāpahetutvāt vanānalaḥ , saḥ bhavadīyasadupadeśajanitajñānaṃ vinā na vārayituṃ śakya iti durvāraḥ| vārayituṃ svayamaśakya ityarthaḥ | dirvāraścāsau saṃsāradavāgniḥ tena taptaṃ dagdhaṃ , vanānalasya vātasahitatve bahuvyāpya tāpakatvaṃ prasiddham|
analyzed: saṃsāraḥ eva dava agniḥ sarvaśas vyāpya tāpa hetu tvāt vanānalaḥ saḥ bhavadīya sat upadeśa janita jñānam vinā na vārayitum śakyaḥ iti durvāraḥ vārayitum svayam aśakyaḥ iti arthaḥ dirvāraḥ ca asau saṃsāra dava agniḥ tena taptam dagdham vanānalasya vāta sahita tve bahu vyāpya tāpaka tvam prasiddham

original: tathā duradṛṣṭavātaiḥ duradṛṣṭāni pāpāni tānyeva vātāḥ pratikūlavāyavaḥ taiḥ dodhūyamānaṃ muhurmuhuḥ kampyamānaṃ, anukūlaścedvātaḥ enamanyatra nayet , pratikūlastu vātaḥ, agnau pātayati agniṃ vā asmin | evaṃ davāgnitaptasya amṛtavarṣaṇe tāpamokṣo bhavatītyabhiprāyeṇa pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭeḥ atikāruṇyasudhābhivṛṣṭyeti viśeṣaṇaṃ dattam |
analyzed: tathā duradṛṣṭa vātaiḥ duradṛṣṭāni pāpāni tāni eva vātāḥ pratikūla vāyavaḥ taiḥ dodhūyamānam muhur muhur kampyamānam anukūlaḥ ced vātaḥ enam anyatra nayet pratikūlaḥ tu vātaḥ agnau pātayati agnim vā asmin evam dava agni taptasya amṛta varṣaṇe tāpa mokṣaḥ bhavati iti abhiprāyeṇa pūrvam dṛṣṭeḥ ati kāruṇya sudhā abhivṛṣṭyā iti viśeṣaṇam dattam

original: tatra bahuvrīhimakṛtvā dṛṣṭyā karaṇena atikāruṇyasudhābhivṛṣṭyā sudhābhivarṣaṇena ityapi vaktuṃ śakyate | tena davāgnitaptaṃ māṃ mṛtyoḥ paripāhītyanvayaḥ | itthaṃ ca svakīyakaṭākṣadṛṣṭyā ṛjvyā māmuddhareti pūrvamanvayaḥ | tayā apikāruṇyasudhābhivarṣaṇena saṃsāradavāgnitaptaṃ māṃ mṛtyḥ paripāhītyuttaratrānvayaḥ |
analyzed: tatra bahuvrīhim a kṛtvā dṛṣṭyā karaṇena ati kāruṇya sudhā abhivṛṣṭyā sudhā abhivarṣaṇena iti api vaktum śakyate tena dava agni taptam mām mṛtyoḥ paripāhi iti anvayaḥ ittham ca svakīya kaṭākṣa dṛṣṭyā ṛjvyā mām uddhara iti pūrvam anvayaḥ tayā api kāruṇya sudhā abhivarṣaṇena saṃsāra dava agni taptam mām mṛtyoḥ paripāhi iti uttaratra anvayaḥ

original: mṛtyorbhītaṃ , prapannaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ, māṃ mṛtyoḥ paripāhītyubhayatrānvayaḥ | bhavadanugrahādātmajñāne sati mama śarīrotkramaṇarūpamaraṇaṃ na sambhavatīti bhāvaḥ | "natasya prāṇā utkrāmanti atraiva samavanīyante" iti śruteḥ |
analyzed: mṛtyoḥ bhītam prapannam śaraṇa āgatam mām mṛtyoḥ paripāhi iti ubhayatra anvayaḥ bhavat anugrahāt ātma jñāne sati mama śarīra utkramaṇa rūpa maraṇam na sambhavati iti bhāvaḥ natasya prāṇāḥ utkrāmanti atra eva samavanīyante iti śruteḥ

original: tathāca "dhṛvaṃ janma mṛtasya ca " ityuktatvāt maraṇābhāve janmābhāvasya siddhatvāt janmamaraṇapravāharūpasaṃsārāt mukto bhavāmi bhavadanugrahe iti bhāvaḥ |svasyānanyaśaraṇatvaṃ gurvābhimukhyāya prakaṭayati śaraṇyamanyaṃ yadahaṃ na jāne iti | bhavadanyaṃ madrakṣakaṃ yat yasmāt ahaṃ na jāne | ato'nanyaśaraṇo'yaṃ nodāsitavya iti bhāvaḥ | ||38||
analyzed: tathā ca dhṛvam janma mṛtasya ca iti ukta tvāt maraṇa abhāve janma abhāvasya siddha tvāt janma maraṇa pravāha rūpa saṃsārāt muktaḥ bhavāmi bhavat anugrahe iti bhāvaḥ svasya ananya śaraṇa tvam guru ābhimukhyāya prakaṭayati śaraṇyam anyam yat aham na jāne iti bhavat anyam mad rakṣakam yat yasmāt aham na jāne atas na anya śaraṇaḥ yam na udāsitavyaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

analyzed: varṣāsu vṛṣṭi bādhā grīṣme tāpaḥ śaradi prārambhe sukham na māsa dvaye yamadaṃṣṭrā tva kīrtanāt hemanta śiśirayoḥ śaityam sugandhi kusuma ākaraḥ vasanta ṛtuḥ kātsnryena lokasya sukham janayati iti vasanta vat iti uktam tadā varṣa tāpa śaitya roga ādīnām abhāvāt

original: sa ṛtuḥ yathā sukhameva janayati tathā lokasya sukhameva tanvānāḥ śāntāḥ nirvikāramanaskāḥ ata eva mahāntaḥ, aparicchinnabrahmasākṣātkāravantaḥ, ata eva tādṛśasadbramābhedena santaḥ " brahmavit brahmaiva bhavatīti śruteḥ, svayaṃ bhīmaḥ bhayaṃkaraḥ yaḥ bhavārṇavaḥ saṃsārasāgaraḥ taṃ tīrṇāḥ asaṃsāriṇa ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: saḥ ṛtuḥ yathā sukham eva janayati tathā lokasya sukham eva tanvānāḥ śāntāḥ nirvikāra manaskāḥ atas eva mahāntaḥ aparicchinna brahma sākṣātkāravantaḥ atas eva tādṛśa sat brama abhedena santaḥ brahma vid brahma eva bhavati iti śruteḥ svayam bhīmaḥ bhayaṃkaraḥ yaḥ bhava arṇavaḥ saṃsāra sāgaraḥ tam tīrṇāḥ asaṃsāriṇaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: svasya āptakāmatvena prayojanābhāvāt ahetunā hetuṃ vinā,anyānapi tārayantaḥ bhavāmbhodhimagnāniti bhāvaḥ| hetuṃ vinā kathaṃ teṣāṃ tattāraṇe nahi svabhāve kāraṇaṃ gaveṣaṇīyam |

original: nahi śarkarāyāṃ mādhuryaṃ kiṃ nimittamiti praśno yujyate tatra tasya svābhāvikatvādityabhiprāyaḥ|paraśramāpanodapravaṇaṃ pareṣāṃ yaśśramaḥ duḥkhaṃ tasyāpanodaḥ nivāraṇaṃ tatra pravaṇaṃ bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ pravaṇabhāvaḥ pravaṇatā saktatā vaiyagryamityarthaḥ| iti yat ayaṃ svabhāvaḥ mahātmanāṃ svata eva |
analyzed: nahi śarkarāyām mādhuryam kim nimittam iti praśnaḥ yujyate tatra tasya svābhāvika tvāt iti abhiprāyaḥ para śrama apanoda pravaṇam pareṣām yaḥ śramaḥ duḥkham tasya apanodaḥ nivāraṇam tatra pravaṇam bhāva pradhānaḥ nirdeśaḥ pravaṇa bhāvaḥ pravaṇa tā sakta tā vaiyagryam iti arthaḥ iti yat ayam svabhāvaḥ mahātmanām svatas eva
